roadmap.title: Grow your first city
roadmap.description: Build one city up from a village and collect the progression, service, district, policy, happiness, weather, and transport achievements as they become available. Do not enable any mods, because active mods disable achievement tracking.

roadmap.title: Reach the late-game milestones
roadmap.description: Keep the same city growing until it passes Milestone 20 and reaches 100,000 residents, buying every map tile and clearing the long building-unlock lists.

roadmap.title: Low-happiness city
roadmap.description: Start a separate city to deliberately push average happiness below 25% without disturbing the main city.

roadmap.title: Editor achievements
roadmap.description: Create and save a map and an asset in the editor; these are independent of any city save.

roadmap.title: Bridges & Ports expansion
roadmap.description: With the Bridges & Ports expansion installed, finish the six maritime and waterfront achievements on a coastal map.

achievements.description: Build city with residential, commercial and industrial zones, water, and electricity.
achievements.sortReason: First automatic unlock in a new city.
achievements.summary: Zone residential, commercial, and industrial areas, then supply them with water and electricity.

steps.text: Start a new city and paint residential, commercial, and industrial zones, then place a water intake and a power plant and connect both to the buildings; the achievement unlocks once the zoned buildings receive water and power.

achievements.description: Have a look at each individual info view panel.
achievements.sortReason: Open every info-view panel once all services are unlocked.
achievements.summary: View each individual info-view panel once.

guide.context: Info views appear as their service becomes available, so every panel exists only after the city reaches Milestone 5, @mechanic{Tiny Town}.

steps.text: Open the info-view selector and click through every panel in the list until each one has been displayed once.

achievements.description: Create a city district and assign a city service to that district.
achievements.sortReason: Do together with the other district and policy achievements.
achievements.summary: Create a district and assign a city service building to it.

steps.text: Draw a district with the district tool, then select a service building such as a clinic or school, open @mechanic{Select operating district}, and choose the district.

achievements.description: Reach enough milestones to unlock all city services in a single city.
achievements.sortReason: Automatic at Milestone 5 as the city grows.
achievements.summary: Unlock all city services in one city by reaching Milestone 5, @mechanic{Tiny Town}.

guide.context: All twelve services unlock by Milestone 5; none of them needs to be built or used, only unlocked.

steps.text: Keep the city growing until the Milestone 5, @mechanic{Tiny Town}, notification appears.

achievements.description: Unlock each building available in the base game.
achievements.sortReason: Longest building-unlock grind; keep for the mature city.
achievements.summary: Unlock every building available in the base game in a single city.

guide.context: Signature buildings from both the North American and European styles count toward this. Service buildings unlock by spending development points in the service development trees, while many signature buildings only unlock once enough regular buildings have reached level 5.

steps.text: In one city, spend development points to buy every node in each service development tree until no service building remains locked.
Check the Signature Buildings menu and meet each listed requirement, leaving the buildings that need level-5 regular buildings until last.
steps.note: Active mods disable achievement tracking, so remove them before this long grind.

achievements.description: Reach a population of 100,000.
achievements.sortReason: Needs a large, mature city.
achievements.summary: Grow a single city to a population of 100,000.

steps.text: Keep zoning housing, jobs, and services so residents keep moving in until the population counter reaches 100,000.

achievements.description: Have 20 active transport lines. These can be passenger or cargo lines or any mix of the two.
achievements.sortReason: Cheese with bus stops once public transport unlocks.
achievements.summary: Have 20 active transport lines in one city, counting passenger and cargo lines.

guide.context: A line counts while it is active, and the lines can be deleted again once the achievement unlocks.

steps.text: Unlock public transport, place two bus stops on one road, and draw a bus line between them; repeat until 20 lines are active at the same time.

achievements.description: Experience a hailstorm.
achievements.sortReason: Waits for a random hailstorm after natural disasters unlock.
achievements.summary: Experience a hailstorm in your city.

guide.context: Storms are random and can only occur after natural disasters unlock at Milestone 4, @mechanic{Grand Village}; a climate with a snowy winter may be required for hail.

steps.text: Reach Milestone 4, @mechanic{Grand Village}, then let the city run until a hailstorm strikes; the achievement unlocks automatically.

achievements.description: Experience a tornado.
achievements.sortReason: Waits for a random tornado after natural disasters unlock.
achievements.summary: Experience a tornado in your city.

guide.context: Tornadoes are random and can only occur after natural disasters unlock at Milestone 4, @mechanic{Grand Village}.

steps.text: Reach Milestone 4, @mechanic{Grand Village}, then let the city run until a tornado forms; the achievement unlocks automatically.

achievements.description: Experience a forest fire.
achievements.sortReason: Waits for a random forest fire after natural disasters unlock.
achievements.summary: Experience a forest fire in your city.

guide.context: Forest fires are random and can only occur after natural disasters unlock at Milestone 4, @mechanic{Grand Village}.

steps.text: Reach Milestone 4, @mechanic{Grand Village}, then let the city run until a forest fire starts; the achievement unlocks automatically.

achievements.description: Have a city that produces 500 MW electricity by only using renewable energy sources.
achievements.sortReason: Needs 500 MW of renewable generation only.
achievements.summary: Produce 500 MW of electricity in one city using only renewable sources.

guide.context: Wind, solar, hydroelectric, and geothermal plants are renewable; coal, gas, nuclear, and waste-incinerator plants are not and must be switched off. The grid must output at least 500 MW in total.

steps.text: Build enough wind, solar, hydroelectric, or geothermal generation for the city to reach 500 MW of output.
Turn off and demolish every coal, gas, nuclear, and waste-incinerator plant, then wait for the grid to update; the achievement unlocks once no non-renewable plant is active.

achievements.description: Build any airport.
achievements.sortReason: Airports cost a development point and a large, funded city.
achievements.summary: Build any airport in a single city.

guide.context: Airports are unlocked by spending development points in the Transportation development tree, so the city must have grown enough to earn them.

steps.text: Grow the city, spend a development point on the @mechanic{Airport} node in the Transportation tree, then place an airport anywhere in the city.

achievements.description: Build 5 signature buildings in a single city.
achievements.sortReason: First step of the signature-building pair.
achievements.summary: Place 5 signature buildings in one city.

guide.context: Signature buildings are placed from the Signature Buildings menu, and each entry unlocks only after its listed city condition is met.

steps.text: Open the Signature Buildings menu and place any 5 signature buildings whose unlock conditions are already met, then let construction finish.

achievements.description: Unlock 150 map tiles in a single city.
achievements.sortReason: Gated by expansion permits from late milestones.
achievements.summary: Own 150 map tiles in one city.

guide.context: Map tiles are bought with expansion permits earned from milestones, and a new city already owns 9 tiles.

steps.text: Buy adjacent map tiles as the city grows until the unlocked total reaches 150; buy the final tiles one at a time.
steps.note: Buying well past 150 in one go can stop the counter from registering, so approach the target slowly.

achievements.description: Have 5 city policies active simultaneously.
achievements.sortReason: Enable five city-wide policies from the City Information panel.
achievements.summary: Have 5 city policies active at the same time.

guide.context: City-wide policies are enabled from the City Information panel, and the last policies unlock at Milestone 10, @mechanic{Small City}.

steps.text: Open the City Information panel and enable at least 5 city-wide policies so they are all active together.

achievements.description: Create 10 districts, each with its own unique set of policies in one city.
achievements.sortReason: Bundle with the other district and policy achievements.
achievements.summary: Create 10 districts in one city that each use a different set of policies.

guide.context: No two districts may share the same combination of policies, so every district needs a policy set that no other district uses.

steps.text: Draw 10 districts with the district tool, then give each district a policy combination that no other district has by enabling different policies or different mixes.

achievements.description: Assign a policy to a city district.
achievements.sortReason: First of the district and policy achievements.
achievements.summary: Set a policy for a city district.

steps.text: Draw a district with the district tool, open its policy list, and enable any policy.

achievements.description: Have at least 1000 citizens and an average happiness rating of 75%.
achievements.sortReason: Happiness city run before the low-happiness run.
achievements.summary: Keep one city above 1,000 residents with average happiness at 75% or higher.

guide.context: Happiness rises from covering citizen needs such as schools, fire and police coverage, healthcare, parks, and reasonable taxes; the happiness icon in the status bar flags unmet needs.

steps.text: Grow the city past 1,000 residents while keeping taxes low and services such as schools, clinics, fire, police, parks in place until the happiness meter reaches 75%.

achievements.description: Follow a citizen's lifepath from childhood to old age.
achievements.sortReason: Start following a child early so the wait overlaps the rest of the city.
achievements.summary: Track one citizen from childhood until they become a senior.

guide.context: Citizens become seniors at age 85, roughly seven to eight in-game years after childhood. Start early and tag several children, because simulation speed drops as the city grows and an individual may die or leave before old age.

steps.text: Open the follow panel and tag two or three child citizens so each is followed for their whole life.
Keep playing the same city until a followed citizen reaches senior age; the achievement unlocks as they cross into old age.

achievements.description: Use the editor to make a map.
achievements.sortReason: Independent editor task.
achievements.summary: Save a map you created in the editor.

steps.text: Open the editor, click @mechanic{Map} in the top-left, enter a map name, click @mechanic{Save Map}, choose a file name, and save.

achievements.description: Unlock 50 map tiles in a single city.
achievements.sortReason: Buy map tiles as the city expands.
achievements.summary: Own 50 map tiles in one city.

guide.context: A new city already owns 9 tiles, so exactly 41 more tiles must be bought to reach 50.

steps.text: Buy 41 map tiles as the city grows so the unlocked total reaches 50; buy the final tiles one at a time.
steps.note: Buying past 50 in one purchase can stop the counter from registering, so approach the target slowly.

achievements.description: Reach milestone 20.
achievements.sortReason: Final milestone; marks the grown city.
achievements.summary: Reach Milestone 20, @mechanic{Megalopolis}, in a single city.

guide.context: This is the final milestone and only requires the city to keep growing.

steps.text: Keep the city growing until the Milestone 20, @mechanic{Megalopolis}, notification appears.

achievements.description: Experience all four seasons by building a city in a climate with a snowy winter.
achievements.sortReason: Play one in-game year in a snowy-winter climate.
achievements.summary: Experience all four seasons in one city on a map where winters are snowy.

guide.context: One in-game day equals one month, so a full in-game year passes all four seasons.

steps.text: Start a city on a map with snowy winters and keep playing until a full in-game year elapses.

achievements.description: Have 50 active transport lines. These can be passenger or cargo lines or any mix of the two.
achievements.sortReason: Extend the bus-line method to fifty lines.
achievements.summary: Have 50 active transport lines in one city, counting passenger and cargo lines.

guide.context: Lines can be deleted again after the achievement unlocks, so a pair of bus stops and repeated lines is enough.

steps.text: Create bus lines between two bus stops until 50 lines are active at the same time.

achievements.description: Use the photo mode to take a screenshot.
achievements.sortReason: One-minute photo-mode task.
achievements.summary: Take a photo in photo mode.

steps.text: Open photo mode with the camera icon at the lower right, then press @mechanic{Take Photo}.

achievements.displayName: This Is Not My Happy Place
achievements.description: Have at least 1000 citizens and an average happiness rating of 25%.
achievements.sortReason: Needs its own city, so it is separated from the main run.
achievements.summary: Keep one city above 1,000 residents with average happiness at 25% or lower.

guide.context: Do this in a separate city so a high-happiness main city is not undone. The debuffs that drive happiness down are polluted water, high crime, high taxes, high water and power fees, polluted air, small homes, and lack of entertainment.

steps.text: In a new city, reach the milestone that unlocks low-rent housing and zone low-rent housing downwind of air pollution from a coal plant or incinerator.
Do not place mail offices, parks, police, fire stations, clinics, or schools so nothing raises citizen happiness.

Build a clean water pump and a second pump next to the sewer outlets with the second one switched off; once about 2,500 people live there, switch on the polluted pump and switch off the sewer outlets.
When polluted water reaches the homes, pause the game, set every service budget to 50%, raise the fees for electricity and water to 200%, and set residential taxes to 30%, then unpause.
Let the city run until the average happiness falls below 25% while more than 1,000 citizens remain.

achievements.description: Build 10 signature buildings in a single city.
achievements.sortReason: Follows Making a Mark once enough signature buildings unlock.
achievements.summary: Place 10 signature buildings in one city.

guide.context: A mature city is needed because each signature building has its own unlock condition, and some conditions only become reachable at high population or service levels.

steps.text: Keep growing one city, check the Signature Buildings menu for newly unlocked entries, and place signature buildings until 10 stand in the city.

achievements.description: Use the editor to make an asset of any other type than a map.
achievements.sortReason: Independent editor task using the duplicate-and-save trick.
achievements.summary: Save an asset you created in the editor.

steps.text: Open the editor, place an object with the house icon, select it in the Objects list, click @mechanic{Duplicate Template}, place the duplicate, then click the save icon beside the new copy in the Objects list.

achievements.description: Have at least 1000 citizens and a city attractiveness rating of 90.
achievements.sortReason: Build up attractiveness alongside the happiness city.
achievements.summary: Reach a city attractiveness rating of 90 with more than 1,000 residents.

guide.context: Buildings that carry the @mechanic{Indoor/Outdoor Recreation} attribute raise attractiveness; examples include parks, landmarks, and the high-school sports field upgrade. The Tourism info view shows the total.

steps.text: Build parks, landmarks, and other recreation buildings until the Tourism info view shows an attractiveness rating of 90, with more than 1,000 residents.

achievements.description: Build a city where at least 15% of the population has a university level of education.
achievements.sortReason: Passive education growth over a long city run.
achievements.summary: Reach a city where at least 15% of the population has a university education.

guide.context: Every education tier needs capacity so citizens can progress from elementary school through university; the Education info view tracks the highly educated share.

steps.text: Provide enough capacity at every education tier, from elementary school through high school, college, and university, then keep the city growing until 15% or more of residents are university educated.

achievements.description: Have a total loan of at least 200,000 in a single city.
achievements.sortReason: Quick loan task once Milestone 3 raises the limit.
achievements.summary: Borrow at least 200,000 in total in one city.

guide.context: The loan limit reaches 200,000 at Milestone 3, @mechanic{Large Village}, and the loan can be repaid after the achievement.

steps.text: Reach Milestone 3, @mechanic{Large Village}, open the loans panel, take the full 200,000 loan, and accept it.

achievements.description: Built 10 Parks & Recreation buildings in a single city.
achievements.sortReason: Place ten parks once Parks & Recreation unlocks.
achievements.summary: Build 10 Parks & Recreation buildings in a single city.

guide.context: Parks & Recreation unlocks at Milestone 4, @mechanic{Grand Village}, and small parks count. If progress stalls, place the parks in a fresh city after that milestone.

steps.text: Open the Parks & Recreation menu and place 10 small parks anywhere in the city.

achievements.description: Plant 100 trees or bushes with the landscaping tool in a single city.
achievements.sortReason: Paint vegetation with the landscaping tool.
achievements.summary: Use the landscaping tool to plant 100 trees or bushes in one city.

steps.text: Open the landscaping menu with the shovel icon, choose a tree or bush from the vegetation tab, enable @mechanic{Place multiple}, and paint over the ground until 100 are planted.

achievements.description: Have buildings from all four zone types in a single city.
achievements.sortReason: Needs office zoning at Milestone 4.
achievements.summary: Have residential, commercial, industrial, and office buildings in one city.

guide.context: Office zoning unlocks at Milestone 4, @mechanic{Grand Village}.

steps.text: Reach Milestone 4, @mechanic{Grand Village}, zone a patch of offices, and wait for the first office building to grow alongside the residential, commercial, and industrial buildings.

achievements.description: Bulldoze a total of 1000 buildings.
achievements.sortReason: Grind 1,000 demolitions with a fast repeat method.
achievements.summary: Demolish a total of 1,000 buildings.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative, so the demolitions do not need to happen in one sitting.

steps.text: While industry demand is high, bulldoze an industry building, let a replacement start on the same spot, and keep demolishing the replacements until 1,000 buildings are gone.

achievements.description: Have 6,000 citizens treated at medical clinics or hospitals in a single city.
achievements.sortReason: Passive medical-treatment count over a large city.
achievements.summary: Get 6,000 citizens treated by clinics or hospitals in one city.

guide.context: The count rises on its own once a clinic exists and usually completes around 55,000 population.

steps.text: Build at least one clinic or hospital and keep the city running until 6,000 citizens have been treated.

achievements.description: Have a total of 6,000 tourist visits in a single city.
achievements.sortReason: Passive tourist count; speed up with parks and landmarks.
achievements.summary: Reach 6,000 total tourist visits in a single city.

guide.context: Tourists arrive once the city is attractive, and extra parks and landmarks draw more of them.

steps.text: Build attractions such as parks and landmarks and keep the city running until the tourist-visit total reaches 6,000.

achievements.description: Build all unique city service buildings in a single city.
achievements.sortReason: Place one of every service building in the mature city.
achievements.summary: Place every unique service building in one city.

guide.context: Signature buildings do not count toward this. A full set needs Milestone 20 and roughly 500 million in the bank.

steps.text: Grow one city to Milestone 20, save up about 500 million, reserve a large flat area, and place one of every service building from the build menus.

achievements.description: Gather 10 000 tons of Fish resource by fishing boats or fish farms in one city.
achievements.sortReason: DLC industry grind; needs a coastal city.
achievements.summary: Collect 10,000 tons of fish in one city using boats or fish farms.

guide.context: Requires the Bridges & Ports expansion. Keep fishing areas away from pollution, and add more areas to gather the total faster.

steps.text: Build a fishing harbor, add as many large fishing areas as possible, connect the fishing routes, and wait until 10,000 tons of @item{fish} have been gathered.

achievements.description: Transfer 24 000 tons of resources through Ports.
achievements.sortReason: DLC port-throughput grind.
achievements.summary: Move 24,000 tons of goods through ports in one city.

guide.context: Requires the Bridges & Ports expansion. Only cargo that moves through a port by ship counts.

steps.text: Build a port main gate with room for its storage buildings, add at least one cargo crane on the water, and connect a cargo ship route, then keep cargo moving until 24,000 tons have shipped.

achievements.description: Gather 2 000 tons of Oil with the offshore oil platforms in one city.
achievements.sortReason: DLC offshore-oil grind; needs offshore oil on the map.
achievements.summary: Extract 2,000 tons of oil using offshore platforms in one city.

guide.context: Requires the Bridges & Ports expansion and a map with offshore oil inside the city's territory.

steps.text: Build the offshore oil drilling hub, add oil platforms and a seaway, connect the oil tanker routes, and wait until 2,000 tons of @item{oil} have been extracted.

achievements.displayName: Draw Me Like One of Your Lift Bridges
achievements.description: Build 5 Draw- or Lift Bridges in one city.
achievements.sortReason: Quick DLC bridge placement.
achievements.summary: Have 5 drawbridges or lift bridges built in one city.

guide.context: Requires the Bridges & Ports expansion. The bridges do not need to cross water, but all five must exist at the same time.

steps.text: Build five drawbridges or lift bridges from the road, highway, train, tram, subway, or pathway menus and leave them in place.

achievements.description: Build 5 kilometers of Quays in one city.
achievements.sortReason: Build several kilometres of quay along a waterfront.
achievements.summary: Build 5 kilometres of quays in one city.

guide.context: Requires the Bridges & Ports expansion. Quays are road or pedestrian networks placed along a shoreline, and only newly built quay length registers, so rebuild over any earlier quays.

steps.text: Select a quay road or pedestrian quay from the Roads or Pathways menu, snap it to a waterfront, and build along the shore until 5 kilometres of quays exist.

achievements.description: Build 2 kilometers of Piers in one city.
achievements.sortReason: Build two kilometres of leisure piers.
achievements.summary: Build 2 kilometres of piers in one city.

guide.context: Requires the Bridges & Ports expansion. Leisure piers are pedestrian paths under Landscaping, and pier length from fishing and offshore-oil hubs also counts.

steps.text: Open Landscaping, select Pathways, choose a leisure pier, and build along the water until the total pier length reaches 2 kilometres.
